title: NimbleRx I NimbleRx and Datascan Partner to Modernize Independent Pharmacy Operations
body_markdown:
*Datascan customers get free access to a patient engagement and fulfillment platform built to save time and increase revenue.*


*‍*


**REDWOOD CITY, CA, November 5, 2026** –[NimbleRx](https://www.nimblerx.com/) , a Swoop company, and[Datascan Pharmacy Software](https://datascanpharmacy.com/) today announced a partnership that gives Datascan pharmacies free access to NimbleRx’s patient engagement and fulfillment platform. The platform helps pharmacy teams save time and earn more revenue from the prescriptions they already fill.


‍


Datascan’s pharmacy management software helps independent pharmacies manage core workflows, including prescriptions, inventory, and point of sale. As patients increasingly expect local pharmacies to offer digital checkout, text updates, and quick refills, NimbleRx adds a patient-facing layer through its mobile app, automated outreach, and digital checkout. These tools help independent pharmacies offer that convenience and preserve the personal care their communities value, while helping them grow revenue.


‍


NimbleRx has been shown to improve medication adherence by 26 percent to 40 percent, supporting patient outcomes and the pharmacy’s bottom line.


‍


**What Datascan pharmacies get with NimbleRx:**


- **Patient messaging:** Automated refill reminders, ready-for-pickup alerts, and HIPPA-compliant two-way texting that keep patients on therapy without staff chasing them by phone.


- **Patient app and digital checkout:** Patients can request refills, pay, and sign ahead of time, so they can walk in and out of their pharmacy faster.


- **Revenue growth:** NimbleRx increases refills, reduces abandoned prescriptions, helps pharmacies recoup processing fees, and pays pharmacies for most orders completed through the platform.


- **Time back for staff:** Automated workflows take over routine follow-ups, so pharmacists and technicians can spend more time on patient care.


‍


With the integration, pick up orders and tasks are synced so pharmacy teams can keep checkout moving without the need to switch back and forth between systems.


‍


“Independent pharmacy owners are looking for ways to grow without adding hours to their team’s day,” said Scott Von Deylen, Head of Pharmacy at Swoop. “Datascan pharmacies now get a platform that handles refill outreach, digital checkout, and patient messaging, and pays them for every order that runs through it. We built NimbleRx so independents can compete on convenience and keep the personal care that sets them apart.”


‍


“Datascan has always focused on giving independent pharmacies software that works as hard as they do. Partnering with NimbleRx extends that by giving our customers patient engagement and fulfillment tools that save their teams time and add revenue, without adding a line item to their budget.” said Sarah Callioras, Vice President, Director of Sales, and Director of Operations at Datascan.


‍


To learn more about the partnership, visit[nimblerx.com/nimblerx-demo-datascan.](https://www.nimblerx.com/nimblerx-demo-datascan)


‍


**About NimbleRx, a Swoop Company**


‍


NimbleRx, a Swoop company, improves patient outcomes by helping patients start therapy faster, stay on treatment longer, and remain connected throughout their healthcare journey. As a prescription fulfillment and patient engagement platform, NimbleRx empowers independent and regional pharmacies to deliver a modern, consumer-friendly healthcare experience while streamlining pharmacy operations.


‍


NimbleRx simplifies every step of the prescription journey, from prescription onboarding and mobile checkout to refills, adherence support, and patient communications. By reducing administrative burden and improving patient engagement, NimbleRx enables pharmacists to spend more time focused on patient care. The platform has been shown to improve medication adherence by 26 percent to 40 percent, helping pharmacies, life sciences companies, and healthcare providers drive better health outcomes at scale.


‍
